# 03 - project walk-up selects the nearest AGENTS.md

Contract: `UPSTREAM-CONTRACT.md` Sec.4.3 - walking up from the instance directory
to the worktree root, the first name in priority order that matches anywhere in
the span wins; one project file per message.

The instance directory is `worktree/applications/service`. Two `AGENTS.md`
files exist (`worktree/AGENTS.md` and `worktree/applications/AGENTS.md`); the
nearer one is selected. `worktree/CLAUDE.md` is deliberately absent so the
selection is unambiguous.
